test_hertz_to_mel: test the hertz_to_mel function converts frequencies from hertz to mel scale with htk, slaney, and kaldi modes
test_mel_to_hertz: test the mel_to_hertz function converts frequencies from mel scale back to hertz with htk, slaney, and kaldi modes
test_mel_filter_bank: test the mel_filter_bank function generates mel filter banks with htk, slaney, and kaldi mel scales and optional slaney normalization
test_spectrogram: test the spectrogram function computes spectrograms from waveforms with configurable window, frame length, hop length, power, center padding, and mel filters
test_spectrogram_batch: test the spectrogram_batch function computes spectrograms for a batch of waveforms with varying lengths and parameters
